episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Munju returns to support a candidate's presidential run. At a mass they attend, a gunshot rings out.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: A mysterious shadow looms over the shooting. Munju enters the presidential race to find the truth.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: A crisis strikes Munju on her way to declare her candidacy. Sanho races in once again to save her.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: A discovery is made that threatens national security.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Munju exposes the plot to start a war and spends what could be her last night with Sanho.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Munju receives some intelligence that changes everything.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Standing at the edge of truth, Munju and Sanho face a choice.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: The shadow of war returns. Munju and Sanho step into the eye of the storm.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Their final strike begins. With the truth in hand, can Munju stop everything before it's too late?
